u.msg: The Signal Stair climbs into cloud, but its first step is a plate of ice that will not give. The Fair's Great Lantern lights this stair from below: relight the Great Lantern (the beacon in the Wintering Square) and the ice will go.

w.msg: A vacant plot beside the Magician's Tower, with a roof-ladder already leaning against it. Joss can build a loft here once a star-reader is willing to move in.
